title: 第1734章 绝冥山脉故技重施第1733章 你还年轻不懂没有力量的悲哀
slug: 玄幻反派仙域最强太子爷
content_zh:
…………
转眼又是三日。
经过数日的连续飞行，夜云三人现在已经在魔族腹地。
期间有魔族见到了仙舟，想着搞事情。
结果刚一靠近，便感受到了焱黎释放出来的恐怖气息。
超强的魔族气息，完全不是普通魔族能够抵抗的。
本想着拦住仙舟，杀光抢光的魔族们，纷纷如惊弓之鸟般溃逃。
本以为对方乘坐的是人族仙舟，上面都是人族，他们出现在魔族腹地，灭了也就灭了。
可谁能想到，这仙舟上竟然还有如此恐怖的魔族存在。
正是因为焱黎，这一路上才能少些不必要的麻烦。
光是想拦路的魔族，就有十波以上。
这些家伙没什么威胁，但很碍事。
夜云不希望在这些低等魔族身上浪费时间，他的目的只是冥鬼教。
当然，在冥鬼教之后还有阴煞魔宗。
此前冥鬼教和阴煞魔宗竟然联合起来共同对付雪门，那只要以冥鬼教教主的名义，将阴煞魔宗宗主约出来应该不是什么难事。
届时，不仅是冥鬼教，阴煞魔宗也能一同灭掉。
既然要报仇，那就要报得更彻底一点。
远处，天空中黑云密布，一眼望去是黑压压的一片。
而在那黑云下方，是一处连绵不断的山脉。
绝冥山脉！

冥鬼教总部就在前方那片连绵不断山脉深处。
而冥鬼教总部之所以隐藏得这么深，就是因为得罪了不少势力。
其中甚至有魔族势力存在，将总部设在此地，自然也是为了安全考虑。
冥鬼教将总部设于山脉深处，并将这片连绵不断的山脉作为外围防护。
在各山脉之间设置有相应的陷阱或是阵法，用以抵御外敌。
真要是有外敌入侵，冥鬼教弟子也会在第一时间察觉到，早做应对。
经过多年时间发展，这片山脉早就已经被冥鬼教经营成铁桶一块。
若是不熟悉山脉中的情况而贸然进入，很可能就是有去无回。
冥鬼教得罪的势力不在少数，到如今却还能安然无恙，必然是有些手段的。
仙舟才刚刚靠近山脉，便能明显地感受到十分浓郁的煞力。
此地必然是用了某种阵法，将周边区域的煞力强行汇聚于此。
这么做，会使得山脉周边的煞力变得稀薄。
刚好能解释夜云他们之前抵达这片区域外围时，明显感觉到煞力突然变得稀薄。
就是因为那些煞力都被抽走了，强行汇聚在这片山脉之中。
只能说不愧是魔族，行事手段果决狠辣。
但这片区域本就是隶属于冥鬼教，就算生活在此地的魔族知道了，也不敢乱来。
得罪了冥鬼教，可没办法在这片区域生存下去。
望着远处的冥鬼教总部，焱黎捏了捏手，一副跃跃欲试的模样。
“主上，现在要怎么办？直接冲进去吗？
不需要主上您亲自动手，由我来即可。”
content_en:
…………
In the blink of an eye, another three days passed.
After several days of continuous flying, Yeyun and the other three were now in the hinterland of the demon clan.
During this period, some demons saw Xianzhou and wanted to cause trouble.
As soon as he got closer, he felt the terrifying aura released by Yan Li.
The super strong demon aura is completely beyond the ability of ordinary demons to resist.
The demons who originally wanted to stop the immortal boat and kill them all fled like frightened birds.
I originally thought that the other party was riding a human fairy boat with human beings on it. They appeared in the hinterland of the demon clan and would be destroyed if they were destroyed.
But who would have thought that there would be such terrifying demons on this immortal boat.
It is precisely because of Yan Li that there will be less unnecessary troubles along the way.
There were more than ten waves of demons just trying to block the way.
These guys aren't a threat, but they are a nuisance.
Ye Yun didn't want to waste time on these low-level demons. His purpose was just the Ghost Cult.
Of course, after the Nether Ghost Sect, there is the Yin Sha Demon Sect.
Previously, the Nether Ghost Sect and the Yin Sha Demon Sect had united to deal with Xuemen. It shouldn't be difficult to invite the leader of the Nether Ghost Sect to come out in the name of the leader of the Nether Ghost Sect.
By then, not only the Nether Ghost Sect, but also the Yin Sha Demon Sect will be destroyed together.
Since you want to take revenge, you must take revenge more thoroughly.
In the distance, the sky was covered with dark clouds, and it looked like a dense mass of darkness.
And under the black clouds, there is a continuous mountain range.
Jueming Mountains!
The headquarters of the Ghost Sect is deep in the rolling mountains ahead.
The reason why the Hell Ghost Cult headquarters is so deeply hidden is because it has offended many forces.
There are even demonic forces among them, so setting their headquarters here is naturally for safety reasons.
The Ghost Cult has its headquarters deep in the mountains and uses this continuous mountain range as outer protection.
Corresponding traps or formations are set up between each mountain range to defend against foreign enemies.
If there is an invasion by a foreign enemy, the disciples of the Underworld Sect will be aware of it as soon as possible and respond early.
After years of development, this mountain range has long been turned into a piece of iron by the Ghost Cult.
If you are not familiar with the conditions in the mountains and enter rashly, you will probably never return.
The Ghost Sect has offended many forces, but it is still safe and sound, so there must be some means.
As soon as the fairy boat approached the mountains, it could clearly feel the strong evil force.
Some kind of formation must have been used here to force the evil forces in the surrounding areas to gather here.
Doing so will make the evil force around the mountains thinner.
It just explains that when Ye Yun and the others arrived at the outside of this area, they clearly felt that the evil force suddenly became thinner.
It's because all the evil power was taken away and forced to gather in this mountain range.
It can only be said that they are worthy of being a demon, and they are decisive and ruthless in their actions.
But this area belongs to the Underworld Cult. Even if the demons living here knew about it, they would not dare to mess around.
If you offend the Underworld Cult, there is no way you can survive in this area.
Looking at the headquarters of the Underworld Cult in the distance, Yan Li squeezed his hands, looking eager to try.
"Lord, what should we do now? Charge in directly?
There is no need for you, Lord, to do it yourself, just let me do it. "
